title: Pre-Analysis Round Two — Forward Cargo Door Surround Lower Corner Fittings

ata.title: Fuselage Section 13 — Forward — Door Surround Structure

abstract: Second round of pre-analysis on the forward cargo door corner reinforcement, re-run against the re-issued freight loading spectrum and closing the repair and harness questions the first round left open.

sections.objective: Re-run the pre-analysis of the forward cargo door corner reinforcement against the re-issued freight loading spectrum, close the two findings the first round left open and decide whether the reinforcement can go to design freeze on the shorter airframe. The scope was narrowed deliberately: the structural conflicts were already established and the second round was asked to settle the repair position, the harness bracket and the inspection content.
sections.findings_summary: Four items were confirmed. The gusset replacement repair remains the hard one, but the re-issued spectrum lowered the required fitting thickness enough that the re-radiused profile now clears the repair fastener pattern on the single-gusset variant, which covers most of the repaired population. The double-gusset variant is still excluded. The harness bracket question closed the other way: the bracket can stay where it is because the fitting hole it picks up is one of the two that did not move. The detailed visual and eddy current inspection is written entirely around the original fitting and needs a post-mod column, and the latch bush bulletin remains worth combining into one door removal.
sections.next_steps: Take the reinforcement to design freeze with the double-gusset variant excluded from the bulletin effectivity, and give that population a target date for a compatible scheme so the exclusion is not read as an abandonment. Re-issue the corner inspection task with pre-mod and post-mod columns and a revised eddy current reference block for titanium. Recommend to the in-service organisation that the latch bush bulletin and the reinforcement are planned into the same door removal wherever the aircraft is eligible for both, and record the expected saving so the recommendation carries some weight.

similarity_seeds: titanium corner fitting at a re-radiused door cut-out
eddy current inspection of a door surround lower corner

tasks.title: Re-run the fitting sizing against the re-issued spectrum
Close the gusset repair compatibility question
Settle the warning harness bracket position
Identify the inspection content to be re-issued

expected_findings.rationale: Re-run against the revised spectrum the fitting is thinner than the first round assumed, and the new cut-out profile clears the single-gusset repair fastener pattern. The double-gusset variant still has fasteners inside the profile and cannot take the reinforcement.
expected_findings.resolution: Single-gusset repairs accepted; double-gusset variant excluded from the bulletin effectivity and offered a separate scheme.

expected_findings.rationale: The detailed visual and eddy current inspection is written around the aluminium fitting: the reference block, the probe frequency and the accept and reject criteria all assume that material. None of it transfers to titanium.
expected_findings.resolution: Task re-issued with pre-mod and post-mod columns and a new reference block for the titanium fitting.

expected_findings.rationale: The latch bush bulletin needs the door off its stops, which is most of the downtime of the reinforcement as well. On aircraft eligible for both, planning them separately doubles a three-shift door removal for no reason.
expected_findings.resolution: Concurrency recommendation issued to the in-service organisation; no change to either bulletin's instructions.

expected_findings.rationale: The fault symptom procedure for a door indication that stays on measures sensor gap against a datum on the surround structure. The reinforcement leaves the datum face where it is but changes the surface finish it is measured from.
expected_findings.resolution: Datum note clarified; no change to the gap values.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares zone 111 and reads as cargo compartment work in the same area, but it is a lining panel standard on the longer airframe with no structural content and no applicability overlap with this reinforcement at all.

type_data.conclusion: Validated. The reinforcement goes to design freeze with the double-gusset repair population excluded and the corner inspection re-issued.
